Apply to restore the placeholders and install bundled Play services 26.32.34 and Play Store 44.5.24, including all Play services splits. GMSCompat applies automatically to these Google-signed packages.

Apply to restore the shared placeholders, then install official microG Services and microG Companion. Enable device registration and Cloud Messaging in microG Settings, and allow unrestricted battery use for microG Services. Reboot after setup. GsfProxy is optional for legacy C2DM apps; on Android 16 its old target SDK requires an ADB install with --bypass-low-target-sdk-block.
